name: Lidar Sphere Tracing
definition: A rendering technique that uses sphere tracing to detect surface intersections (Lidar points) from a camera, storing them in a point cloud, and then projecting these points onto the framebuffer for visualization, rather than rendering the full volumetric or geometric scene directly.
summary: Lidar Sphere Tracing adapts distance-field ray marching to simulate LiDAR data by projecting sparse point clouds onto a framebuffer, discarding shading for occlusion-aware color maps.
